spots.bio: Losa Beach is one of Rotuma's best beaches, with the 25 m deep Manfiri volcanic vent between it and Solroroa Bluff.
spots.notes: Wikivoyage Rotuma: best beaches are Oinafa, Losa and Vai'oa, west of Solroroa Bluff; Manfiri vent lies between Losa beach and Solroroa Bluff. No Wikipedia article for the beach. Free by place type, no fee source.

spots.bio: Vai'oa Beach is one of Rotuma's best beaches, on the island's west side near Solroroa Bluff.
spots.notes: Wikivoyage Rotuma only. No Wikipedia article. Free by place type.
unverified: 'listed' cut (source reference); west side per Wikivoyage

spots.bio: Oinafa is one of Rotuma's finest beaches, on the island's west side near Solroroa Bluff.
spots.notes: Wikivoyage Rotuma names Oinafa among the best beaches; Wikipedia 'Oinafa' is the district article (one of seven districts), not the beach, so no wiki field. Note: Wikivoyage says Oinafa, Losa and Vai'oa are 'west of Solroroa Bluff', conflicting with 'east' in the draft; location unverified.
unverified: 'named in the guide' cut (source named in text); west side per Wikivoyage
